HOW TO PLAY

Your world. Your rules.

Nations claim land, earn gold, form alliances, and fight for territory. Sea crossings are limited to nearby shores connected by at most four water tiles. Strong economies and combat efficiency help win battles. Long wars lower stability and can trigger revolutions.

  • Inspect: click a nation, or select it from the ranking.
  • God mode: rename, recolor, donate gold, change combat efficiency, force war or peace, ally, annex, revolt, or collapse.
  • Map editor: place nations and paint land, sea, or ownership. Time only advances when you press Next turn. Undo restores the last stroke.
  • Diplomacy map: green marks allies, red marks enemies of your selected nation.
  • Navigation: drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Space advances one turn. Escape returns to Inspect.
